title: Repair-vs-Replace Savings Log
dataSources: Carbon estimates (`carbon:estimate`), recycling weight (`recycling:weight`), food waste (`foodwaste:log`), repairs (`repair:event`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — carbon-footprint apps, home recycling scales, food-waste logs, and repair / reuse journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=repair:event
| stats sum(eval(replace_cost-repair_cost)) as saved, count as repairs by category
| sort - saved
description: Totals the money and waste saved by repairing things instead of replacing them.
value: Quantifying repair savings rewards the fix-it habit and pushes back on the throwaway default.
implementation: Ingest repair events into `index=personal`; total savings versus replacement cost.
visualization: Bar chart of repair savings by category.
grandmaExplanation: It totals the money you save by fixing things instead of buying new, rewarding the repair habit.
